Question: What is the virtues of dua e qunoot? (2)can a hanafi read the qunoot of shaafies in his witr? Answer ID: 1278 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 367/367=L) (1) I do not remember any Hadith regarding the same. (2) Yes, it is allowed: ولو قرأ غیرہ جاز (فتح القدیر: 1/446) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
